packageRules.description: uv is pinned in three places that must move together (pyproject required-version, setup-uv version, this image); bump them by hand, see CLAUDE.md.

pyproject.toml ranges are what installers resolve against (some are security floors); exact versions live in uv.lock. Overrides the central rangeStrategy: pin, which turned every range into an == pin in #157.
requires-python is the supported-interpreter floor, not a dependency. Pinning it to ==3.14.7 in #157 rejected the 3.12 that .python-version and the test matrix use, and every CI job failed at setup.
